1. GET http://127.0.0.1:8132/audits/last and read integer `last_seq`.
2. GET http://127.0.0.1:8132/inquiries?after=N using that last_seq. The response contains up to 200 inquiries, each with integer `seq` and string `text`.
3. If no inquiries are returned, make no POST and finish silently.
4. Otherwise evaluate every fetched inquiry. Count an inquiry as urgent if it involves a charge, billing amount, or refund of $250 or more, OR if the customer says they are blocked from working. All others are normal.
5. POST one JSON object to http://127.0.0.1:8132/audits with exactly these keys: `batch_start_seq` (minimum fetched seq), `batch_end_seq` (maximum fetched seq), `urgent_count` (integer count of urgent fetched inquiries), `total_count` (integer count of all fetched inquiries), and `urgent_fraction` (JSON number equal to urgent_count / total_count rounded to exactly two decimal places mathematically; for example 1/4 becomes 0.25 and 2/3 becomes 0.67).

Use curl/HTTP tooling as needed. Parse responses and construct JSON programmatically. Validate exact keys, integer counts, batch boundaries, and the rounded fraction before POSTing; fail rather than post a partial or invalid audit. Do not produce user-facing output for an empty or successful run.

import json, urllib.request
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

base='http://127.0.0.1:8132'
inquiries = [
 {"seq":41,"text":"Your duplicate charge overdrew our account and we are blocked from working until it is repaid."},
 {"seq":42,"text":"Please reverse yesterday's charge of $310; I did not authorize it."},
 {"seq":43,"text":"Is the annual plan still available at last year's rate if we sign this week?"},
 {"seq":44,"text":"Is the annual plan still available at last year's rate if we sign this week?"},
 {"seq":45,"text":"How do I change which email address gets billing receipts?"},
 {"seq":46,"text":"Can we schedule a demo of the mobile app for our procurement committee?"},
 {"seq":47,"text":"We're comparing vendors this quarter — can someone walk us through pricing tiers?"},
 {"seq":48,"text":"My card was billed $310 after I cancelled — please send my money back."},
 {"seq":49,"text":"Where do I update our company's billing address for future invoices?"},
 {"seq":50,"text":"The export button downloads an empty file every time I click it."}
]
urgent_seqs={41,42,48}
seqs=[q['seq'] for q in inquiries]
urgent_count=sum(q['seq'] in urgent_seqs for q in inquiries)
total_count=len(inquiries)
fraction=(Decimal(urgent_count)/Decimal(total_count)).quantize(Decimal('0.00'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
values={
 'batch_start_seq':min(seqs),
 'batch_end_seq':max(seqs),
 'urgent_count':urgent_count,
 'total_count':total_count,
}
assert set(values)=={'batch_start_seq','batch_end_seq','urgent_count','total_count'}
assert all(isinstance(v,int) and not isinstance(v,bool) for v in values.values())
assert values=={'batch_start_seq':41,'batch_end_seq':50,'urgent_count':3,'total_count':10}
assert fraction==Decimal('0.30') and fraction.as_tuple().exponent==-2
body=('{' +
      f'"batch_start_seq":{values["batch_start_seq"]},' +
      f'"batch_end_seq":{values["batch_end_seq"]},' +
      f'"urgent_count":{values["urgent_count"]},' +
      f'"total_count":{values["total_count"]},' +
      f'"urgent_fraction":{fraction:.2f}' + '}').encode()
parsed=json.loads(body)
assert set(parsed)=={'batch_start_seq','batch_end_seq','urgent_count','total_count','urgent_fraction'}
assert all(isinstance(parsed[k],int) and not isinstance(parsed[k],bool) for k in ('batch_start_seq','batch_end_seq','urgent_count','total_count'))
assert body.decode().endswith('"urgent_fraction":0.30}')
req=urllib.request.Request(base+'/audits',data=body,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
    if not (200 <= r.status < 300): raise RuntimeError(r.status)
